direction: Martin portfolio mandate; Codex brief, synthesis, integration and implementing-agent review

art.reviewed_but_not_shipped: First Warden generation exec-c1649f6d-cfaf-4e4d-aa33-0b6ac5538bca cut the upper prongs; a reference edit corrected framing. Runner uses that first image as style reference. No external reference artwork imported.
art.brief: Painted navy/slate, bronze/violet Warden and teal courier; broad static silhouettes, transparent character backgrounds, low-contrast overhead paving with no implied collision. Telegraphs, state rings and columns stay authored native geometry.

art.limits: The original portrait/floor PNGs are unchanged. Motion production below adds four-keyframe clips and two mirrored orientations, not a hand-animated eight-direction production set. Independent visual/play approval remains absent.

audio.origin: Original deterministic algorithmic score and synthesis; no external samples, MIDI, vocals or historical masters.
audio.score: 80 BPM, 8 bars, D/F/E-flat motif and low sustained fifth; quiet bronze bells versus denser phase-two pulse. Two aligned 24s mono transports.
audio.delivery: Two PCM16/44.1kHz WAV masters, two Vorbis runtime loops and fourteen short PCM cues. Eight pooled positional voices, -1.5dB limiter, equal-power crossfade, explicit mute/pause/restart.
audio.review: PCM/hash/endpoint checks plus real AudioServer capture, isolated cue, lifecycle and gain-stress execution. No physical speaker/headphone or human listening claim.

rights: New model-generated images and Codex-authored synthesis under the authorized project scope. No third-party media imported; exclusive copyright, non-infringement and commercial clearance have not been established.
path_scope: Media paths are relative to projects/veil-arena; evidence is relative to the lab.

motion.brief: Same masked navy/teal courier and bronze/slate/purple Warden; sixteen poses each, corrected for isolated transparent cells. Courier walk/blade/dodge/seal; Warden walk/sweep/charge/wave. No external reference media.
motion.modification: Accepted PNGs copied unchanged; native tools/build_motion_catalog.gd reads alpha and derives foot pivots/regions/scale. Runtime mirrors frames; no pixel cleanup or invented extra animation assets.
motion.integration: motion.gd selects frames from actual body displacement, contact emission and boss stages. Pause/result freeze clocks; restart clears them.
motion.limits: Implementing-agent review only. Generated pose/proportion variation, four-keyframe clips, horizontal mirroring; no hand-animated interpolation, full directional coverage or independent audience approval.
